name: Potion of Gaseous Form
summary: A potion that turns you into a misty cloud as the Gaseous Form spell.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the *{ref:spell/gaseous-form}* spell for 1 hour (no Concentration required) or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.

This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.
